cards.title: HOW TO PLAY
cards.text:
Raise the drawbridge and hit the castle gate to smash it open. Shoot through the open gate to destroy the castle.
Light and play the modes to rescue the princess, fight trolls and defeat the dragon.

cards.title: TIPS
cards.text: Hit the trolls when they pop up. Destroy castles to build toward Royal Madness. The catapult and Merlin's magic give extra awards.
